voice.summary: Quillstream writes like a senior engineer's good README: terse, example-first and respectful of time. It shows the code before explaining it and promises only what the API does.
dos: Show a working snippet before the explanation
State limits, versions and status exactly
Use second person and the imperative mood
donts: Do not claim 'zero latency' or 'infinite scale'
Do not use jargon without a link

taglines: Ship real-time features in an afternoon
Docs you can copy and paste
Build on a socket you can trust
boilerplate: Quillstream provides a real-time events API with SDKs for Node and Python, along with guides, references and copy-and-paste examples for developers.

microcopy.success: Copied. Paste it into your terminal.
microcopy.error: No results for that search. Try a method name or a guide title.

logo.note: A pulse line suggests a live stream of events.
